name: agape-production-conformance
description: Black-box production-path conformance for the shipped Agape CLI.

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:optional-memory && npm run test:studio-fact-checker
scripts.test:core: npm run test:allocated -- --profile core-agent --target source --os linux --lane standard
scripts.test:optional-memory: npm run test:allocated -- --profile optional-memory --target source --os linux --lane standard
scripts.test:studio-fact-checker: npm run test:allocated -- --profile studio-fact-checker --target source --os linux --lane standard
scripts.test:research: npm run test:allocated -- --profile research --target source --os linux --lane standard
scripts.test:research:slow: npm run test:allocated -- --profile research --target source --os linux --lane slow
